fact: Senegal's Data and Police Information Collection and Registration Centre (CREDIPOL/DACORE) and its automated police information database, created by decree 2021-1213 of 29 September 2021 under a memorandum with INTERPOL of 19 June 2019, were inaugurated in Dakar on 17 May 2022 with police officers and gendarmes seconded to the centre by ruling of the Ministers of the Interior and of the Armed Forces; the newsletter, produced with European Union funding, describes extension of the system beyond the DACOREs as the phase then starting.
title: WAPIS Newsletter Number 20, August 2022
